{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
find /working -print0 | xargs -0 ls -ld > temp_workspace/listing.raw
grep -E "/workspace$" temp_workspace/listing.raw > temp_workspace/matches.txt
# Step 3 & 4: Filter for regular files and create status.txt
if [ -s temp_workspace/matches.txt ]; then
    > temp_workspace/matches.confirmed
    found=false
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Extract path. ls -ld output usually ends with the path.
        # But handle spaces if any.
        path=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $NF}')
        if [ -f "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ]; then
            echo "$line [CONFIRMED]" >> temp_workspace/matches.confirmed
            found=true
        fi
    done < temp_workspace/matches.txt
    mv temp_workspace/matches.confirmed temp_workspace/matches.txt
    if [ "$found" = true ]; then
        echo "found" > temp_workspace/status.txt
    else
        echo "not_found" > temp_workspace/status.txt
    fi
else
    echo "not_found" > temp_workspace/status.txt
fi
cat temp_workspace/status.txt
"}
